recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast composition featuring a photorealistic woman in profile wearing stylized, organic purple metallic armor, set against a stylized comic-book-style night cityscape with sharp perspective and a deep purple sky.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between realistic skin textures and cel-shaded architectural backgrounds
Color harmony between the purple armor, sky, and building shadows
Dynamic upward perspective of skyscrapers framing the central figure
Graphic spotlight element creating a focal point behind the subject's head
coreInvariants: Deep purple and indigo color palette
Dramatic low-angle perspective on the city

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large central figure positioned in the right two-thirds of the frame, shown from the waist up in a three-quarter profile.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the sharp, metallic collar of the armor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the metallic title in the top left, follow the curve of the text down to the subject's face, then down the lines of the armor into the city perspective.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with architectural detail and the subject.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep purple and dark indigo for the sky and building shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm skin tones and bright cyan/blue highlights on the building windows.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Metallic lavender and magenta for the armor highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the dark buildings and the bright, glowing window lights and metallic reflections.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to cool-toned purples and blues

characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters have a chrome-like finish with internal glows
Outer stroke follows the arched path of the word block
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A heavy 3D display face paired with a simpler, arched sans-serif for secondary information.

preserve: Arched baseline for the second line

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and vertical presence for the main title.
Clean geometric skeletons suitable for the secondary arched text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a digital illustration of a woman in profile with braided cornrows, wearing intricate purple bio-organic metallic armor. The background should be a comic-book style night city with towering skyscrapers in deep purple and blue tones, using sharp perspective lines and glowing windows. Include a white heart-shaped spotlight beam in the sky.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, 3D beveled silver title in the top left corner using a heavy sans-serif font. Below it, add a second line of text in white, arched upwards, with a purple outer glow.

verificationChecks: Is the armor metallic and purple?
Is the city rendered in a cel-shaded or comic style?
Is the perspective looking up at the buildings?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the purple color cast
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: Clean vector-like edges on the city
High-gloss metallic reflections on the armor

postGenerationChecks: Check that the armor looks like a physical object on the subject.
Ensure the city perspective converges correctly.
Verify the text is clearly legible against the dark sky.
Confirm the purple color palette is consistent across all elements.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Photorealistic Subject] + [Organic Metallic Armor] + [Comic-Style Night Cityscape] + [3D Beveled Typography] using a [Monochromatic Purple Base] with [High Contrast Highlights].
